items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I used to play with him. We used to play at the Allstars for $15 a week.

ctx.x: Miss Donegan, can you tell me about Hillard Brown’s band?
Yeah, I used to play with him. We used to play at the Allstars for $15 a week.
$15 for the whole band or for you?
